s0011.en: President of the Airsoft Club. Deeply responsible, her motto in any situation is "We all go home together." Her shooting is textbook-precise.
s0011.zh: 生存游戏社社长。责任感极强，无论何时都把「大家一起回家」挂在嘴边。射击精准，堪称教科书。

s0014.en: For {}s: fire rate +{}%, no ammo used

s0020.en: Just transferred in and still wearing her old school's sailor uniform. Top of her class, and with a pistol she can hit a vital spot in one shot. Her father is a doctor at the city hospital.
s0020.zh: 刚转学过来，还穿着前一所学校的水手服。头脑全年级第一，用手枪一发就能击穿要害。父亲是市立医院的医生。

s0021.zh: 精准射击：暴击率+{}%，暴击伤害+{}%

s0023.en: Locks on to up to {} enemies on screen and fires piercing rounds through them
s0023.zh: 锁定画面内最多{}名敌人，用穿透弹将其击穿

s0029.en: A blonde, twin-tailed former ace of the softball club. Pulls the trigger before she thinks. Looks out for her little brother, and croquettes are her favorite food.
s0029.zh: 金发双马尾，前垒球社王牌。想都不想就先扣扳机。很疼弟弟，最爱吃可乐饼。

s0030.zh: 坚韧：受到伤害-{}%，近距离伤害+{}%

s0032.en: An invincible charge that bowls enemies over and stuns them, ending in a shockwave. Then for {}s: damage taken halved, damage +{}%, ammo fully restored
s0032.zh: 无敌冲锋撞飞并击晕敌人，在停下处释放冲击波。之后{}秒内，受到伤害减半，伤害+{}%，弹药全满

s0038.en: A silver-haired first-year who breaks school rules while still wearing her discipline committee armband. One hand shoots, the other is a spare. Her homemade drone "Pochi" counts as club equipment.
s0038.zh: 戴着风纪委员袖章照样违反校规的银发一年级生。一只手开枪，另一只手备用。自制无人机「波奇」被算作社团公物。

s0039.en: Nimble: Move speed +{}%, Weapon & Armor Crate drop rate +{}%
s0039.zh: 身手敏捷：移动速度+{}%，武器箱与护甲箱掉落率+{}%

s0041.en: Calls a support drone that auto-fires at enemies for {}s
s0041.zh: 召唤支援无人机，在{}秒内自动射击敌人

s0047.en: The new member whose catchphrase is "Firepower is justice, Senpai!" She hauled an anti-tank bazooka out of the school festival storeroom. Small, but strong.
s0047.zh: 口头禅是「火力就是正义，前辈！」的新社员。从文化祭仓库里扛出了一门反坦克火箭筒。个子小小，力气却很大。

s0048.en: Demolition Fanatic: Blast radius +{}%, explosion damage +{}%
s0048.zh: 爆破狂：爆炸范围+{}%，爆炸伤害+{}%

s0050.en: Fires {} rockets in a row. Big explosions no matter what weapon is equipped
s0050.zh: 连射{}发火箭弹。无论装备什么武器都会引发大爆炸

s0064.en: In stock at Yui's Bond Lv MAX

s0065.en: A rifle tuned just for Yui, with "We all go home together" carved into the stock. No quirks, and accurate all the way.
s0065.zh: 枪托上刻着「大家一起回家」，专为结衣调校的步枪。毫无怪癖，无论多远都精准。

s0067.en: In stock at Rei's Bond Lv MAX

s0068.en: A suppressed pistol Rei built herself. Nobody notices it fire except the one pulling the trigger.
s0068.zh: 玲亲手组装的消音手枪。除了开枪的人，谁也察觉不到。

s0070.en: In stock at Haru's Bond Lv MAX

s0071.en: A machine gun Haru wrapped in bat grip tape. Enemies it hits go flying into the stands.
s0071.zh: 春缠上球棒握把带的机枪。被击中的敌人会一路飞进看台。

s0073.en: In stock at Mio's Bond Lv MAX

s0074.en: An SMG built from spare parts for the drone "Pochi." Its cryo rounds slow enemies down.
s0074.zh: 用无人机「波奇」的备用零件做成的冲锋枪。冷却弹能让敌人步履迟缓。

s0076.en: In stock at Nana's Bond Lv MAX

s0077.en: A twin-barrel bazooka Nana modded with the school festival budget. "Firepower is justice!"
s0077.zh: 奈奈挪用文化祭预算改造的双联火箭筒。「火力就是正义！」

s0079.en: In stock at Yui & Rei's Bond Lv MAX
s0079.zh: 结衣与玲羁绊等级MAX时上架

s0080.en: A sniper rifle the captain and vice captain have taken turns using. The scope bears both their adjustments.
s0080.zh: 社长与副社长轮流使用的狙击枪。瞄准镜上留着两人的调校痕迹。

s0082.en: In stock at Haru & Nana's Bond Lv MAX
s0082.zh: 春与奈奈羁绊等级MAX时上架

s0083.en: A rapid-fire shotgun that sears enemies with fresh-from-the-fryer heat. Co-developed by a glutton and a demolition fanatic.
s0083.zh: 以刚出锅的热度灼烧敌人的连发霰弹枪。由吃货与爆破狂共同开发。

s0085.en: In stock after clearing all of Chapter {} on Hard
s0085.zh: 以困难难度全通第{}章后上架

s0086.en: A special model engraved with the school crest. Left behind by a graduate, it's the best-kept gun in the whole school.
s0086.zh: 刻有校徽的特别款。由毕业生留下，是全校保养得最好的一把枪。

s0088.en: An SMG charged with power from the overhead train lines. Its rounds shock enemies in their tracks.
s0088.zh: 蓄满架空电线电力的冲锋枪。子弹让敌人触电而停下脚步。

s0090.en: A sniper rifle the color of sunrise. Wreathes the enemies it pierces in flame.
s0090.zh: 朝霞色的狙击枪。被击穿的敌人会被火焰包裹。

s0092.en: In stock after clearing all of Chapter {} on Nightmare
s0092.zh: 以噩梦难度全通第{}章后上架

s0093.en: A shotgun with a cleaver attached, found at the back of a butcher shop's freezer. Its {} pellets pierce through enemies.
s0093.zh: 在肉铺冷库深处找到的、装着剁肉刀的霰弹枪。{}颗霰弹都能穿透敌人。

s0095.en: A flare pistol once used to signal train departures. Bursts on every hit.
s0095.zh: 曾用于发车信号的信号枪。每次命中都会炸裂。

s0097.en: A prototype grenade launcher found in the director's lab. Fires {} in a row to blow away a wide area.
s0097.zh: 在院长研究室发现的试作榴弹枪。{}连发，炸飞大片区域。

s0099.en: A machine gun pieced together from the wreckage of the generator. It turns the Fog itself into bullets and never stops firing.
s0099.zh: 用发生炉残骸组装的机枪。把雾本身化为子弹，不停射击。

s0101.en: An automatic pistol also issued to the police. Light, and crits easily.
s0101.zh: 警察也在配备的自动手枪。轻巧，容易打出暴击。

s0103.en: A pistol that fires full-auto. A little bucking bronco that sprays bullets everywhere.
s0103.zh: 可以全自动射击的手枪。到处泼洒子弹的小烈马。

s0105.en: A {}-shot revolver. Every round hits hard and pierces {} enemies.
s0105.zh: {}连发转轮手枪。每一发都很沉重，可穿透{}名敌人。

s0107.en: A {} caliber you're not meant to fire one-handed. Rifle-grade power that skewers {} enemies.
s0107.zh: 不该单手开的{}口径。拥有步枪级威力，可贯穿{}名敌人。

s0109.en: A lab-made electromagnetic pistol. Fire rate and power in one: the pinnacle of handguns.
s0109.zh: 研究所制造的电磁手枪。兼顾射速与威力，手枪的巅峰之作。

s0111.en: A lightweight rifle adapted to serve as a machine gun. Haru's favorite.
s0111.zh: 把步枪改作机枪使用的轻量型号。春的爱枪。

s0113.en: An anti-tank rocket that was gathering dust in the festival storeroom. Flies straight and explodes.
s0113.zh: 沉睡在文化祭仓库里的反坦克火箭。直线飞行后爆炸。

s0115.en: The standard rifle from the club's equipment locker. Straightforward and easy to handle.
s0115.zh: 社团器材柜里的标准步枪。中规中矩，容易上手。

s0117.en: A short rifle with its action set behind the grip. Handy, with a quick reload.
s0117.zh: 机匣后置的短步枪。操控灵活，装弹也快。

s0119.en: A tough rifle rumored to work even after a mud bath. Every round hits hard and pierces {} enemies.
s0119.zh: 据说泡过泥水也照样能用的结实步枪。每一发都很沉重，可穿透{}名敌人。

s0121.en: A large-caliber rifle that leans semi-auto. High accuracy and range, and crits easily.
s0121.zh: 偏半自动的大口径步枪。精度与射程出色，容易打出暴击。

s0123.en: A prototype electromagnetic rifle from Helios Pharmaceuticals. Its high-velocity rounds pierce {} enemies.
s0123.zh: 赫利俄斯制药的试作电磁步枪。高初速子弹可贯穿{}名敌人。

s0125.en: A small, light SMG. Spray bullets while you run circles around them.
s0125.zh: 小巧轻便的冲锋枪。可以边跑边泼洒子弹。

s0127.en: An oddball with a {}-round magazine mounted on top. Rarely runs dry.
s0127.zh: 顶部装着{}发弹匣的个性派。不容易断弹。

s0129.en: A system that channels recoil downward gives it a staggering fire rate. Runs dry in no time.
s0129.zh: 将后坐力向下导出的机构带来惊人射速。弹药转眼就空。

s0131.en: An old SMG that Mio souped up beyond recognition. Don't let its looks fool you: its firepower is top-class.
s0131.zh: 被澪魔改过的老式冲锋枪。别看外表，火力可是一流。

s0133.en: A plasma-round SMG found in a lab. A storm of bullets.
s0133.zh: 在研究所发现的等离子弹冲锋枪。暴风般的弹幕。

s0135.en: The classic ka-chunk pump-action. Blows away every enemy that gets too close.
s0135.zh: 咔嚓作响的经典泵动式。把靠近的敌人一并轰飞。

s0137.en: A double-barrel with its barrels cut short. Holds only {} shells, but hits like a truck.
s0137.zh: 截短枪管的双管枪。只能装{}发，但威力巨大。

s0139.en: A semi-auto shotgun with a box magazine. Rapid fire pushes back the horde.
s0139.zh: 使用盒式弹匣的半自动霰弹枪。以连射击退尸群。

s0141.en: Spews incendiary shot on full auto. Sets enemies it hits on fire.
s0141.zh: 全自动喷吐燃烧霰弹。命中的敌人会燃烧起来。

s0143.en: An anti-materiel shotgun that blows away the door and whoever's behind it. Zombies fly to the edge of the screen.
s0143.zh: 连门带人一起轰飞的反器材霰弹枪。僵尸会飞到画面边缘。

s0145.en: A bolt-action sniper rifle. Pierces up to {} enemies lined up in a row.
s0145.zh: 栓动式狙击枪。可贯穿排成一列的最多{}名敌人。

s0147.en: A semi-auto designated marksman rifle. Snipe shot after shot.
s0147.zh: 半自动精确射手步枪。可以连续狙击。

s0149.en: A special sniper rifle with a built-in suppressor. The luxury of a sniper that fires rapidly.
s0149.zh: 一体式消音器的特种狙击枪。能连射的狙击，堪称奢侈。

s0150.zh: 反器材步枪 百臂巨人

s0151.en: A monster built to stop armored vehicles. The screen shakes with every shot.
s0151.zh: 为拦下装甲车而生的怪物。每开一枪画面都会震动。

s0153.en: A prototype that launches rounds by electromagnetic acceleration. Pierces everything in its line of fire.
s0153.zh: 以电磁加速发射子弹的试作兵器。贯穿射线上的一切。

s0155.en: {}-round belt feed. Keeps firing, but reloads take forever.
s0155.zh: {}发弹链供弹。可以持续射击，但装弹很慢。

s0157.en: Hammers in heavy rounds without end. Punches holes in zombie lines.
s0157.zh: 源源不断地砸进重型子弹。在僵尸队列中打出缺口。

s0159.en: Nicknamed for a rate of fire that sounds like tearing cloth. Sheer violence by bullet storm.
s0159.zh: 因撕裂布匹般的连射声而得名。弹幕即暴力。

s0161.en: A rotary multi-barrel gun. Once it starts spinning, nothing in front of it is left standing.
s0161.zh: 回转式多管枪。一旦转起来，眼前便什么都不剩。

s0163.en: A break-action, single-shot grenade launcher. Lobs in an arc and explodes.
s0163.zh: 折开式单发榴弹发射器。沿抛物线飞行后爆炸。

s0165.en: A {}-shot revolving-cylinder launcher. Back-to-back blasts wipe out the horde.
s0165.zh: {}连发转轮弹仓式。连续轰炸把尸群炸得灰飞烟灭。

s0167.en: An anti-tank rocket. Flies straight and clears the area with a huge blast.
s0167.zh: 反坦克火箭。直线飞行，以大爆炸横扫周围。

s0169.en: An orb cannon built on repurposed generator tech. Bursts as it pierces.
s0169.zh: 转用发生炉技术的光球炮。边贯穿边爆裂。

s0171.en: A fishing co-op speargun, shrunk down to pistol size. Its harpoon skewers up to {} enemies.
s0171.zh: 把渔协仓库里的水下枪缩成手枪大小。鱼叉最多可串起{}名敌人。

s0173.en: A seaside vigilante model with an anti-salt coating. Keeps running even with sand in it.
s0173.zh: 涂有防盐蚀涂层的海边自卫队规格。进了沙子也不卡壳。

s0175.en: An SMG that seems to hold the lightning of a summer storm. Its rounds shock enemies.
s0175.zh: 仿佛封存了夏日骤雨雷电的冲锋枪。子弹能让敌人触电。

s0177.en: The beach shack owner insists it's "for watermelon splitting." Blasts enemies to the far end of the beach.
s0177.zh: 海边小店老板坚称是「劈西瓜用的」霰弹枪。能把敌人轰到海滩尽头。

s0179.en: An old sniper rifle that hung on the lighthouse landing. Its red and white bands are a marker visible from the sea.
s0179.zh: 挂在灯塔楼梯平台上的老狙击枪。红白相间的条纹，是从海上也能看见的标记。

s0181.en: A rotary gun fitted with a cold-storage cooling unit. Freezes the legs of the enemies it hits.
s0181.zh: 装载冷冻仓库冷却装置的转管枪。冻住被击中敌人的双脚。

s0183.en: Fireworks Nana brought to training camp, rigged to fire tube and all. Sets the whole night sky ablaze.
s0183.zh: 奈奈带去集训的烟花，连筒一起改成了能发射的武器。连夜空一起点燃。

s0185.en: The latest model, carried by the security chief of Lab No. 4. A barrage as unbroken as the tides.
s0185.zh: 第四研究所警备主任所持的最新型。如潮涨潮落般连绵不绝的弹幕。

s0187.en: An electromagnetic accelerator cannon for deep-sea exploration. Its light reaches the ocean floor and pierces everything in its line of fire.
s0187.zh: 深海探测用的电磁加速炮。直达海底的光芒贯穿射线上的一切。

s0189.en: Twin-launches the giant shells meant for a summer festival finale. The blast sites keep burning for a while.
s0189.zh: 双联发射夏日祭压轴用的大号烟花弹。爆炸处会持续燃烧一段时间。

s0197.en: Pierce +{}, damage +{}%. Armor and shields don't reduce damage
s0197.zh: 穿透+{}，威力+{}%。不受装甲和盾牌削减威力

s0200.en: Damage +{}%, mag size +{}%, reload time -{}%, crit +{}%
s0200.zh: 威力+{}%，弹匣容量+{}%，装弹时间-{}%，暴击率+{}%

s0221.zh: 威力+{}%，爆炸范围+{}%，装弹时间-{}%

s0224.en: No slowdown while firing; massive knockback
s0224.zh: 射击时不减速，超强击退

s0225.en: A mini drone provides constant covering fire
s0225.zh: 小型无人机持续提供掩护射击

s0227.en: Always crits while your partner is standing

s0233.en: Enemies hit burn for {}s, taking damage over time
s0233.zh: 命中的敌人会燃烧{}秒，持续受到伤害

s0234.en: Each hit has a {}% chance to shock the enemy, stopping it in place
s0234.zh: 每次命中有{}%几率使敌人触电，令其停止行动

s0236.en: Each hit sets off a small explosion that catches nearby enemies
s0236.zh: 每次命中都会引发小爆炸，波及周围敌人

s0240.en: pellets. More hit at close range
s0240.zh: 颗霰弹。距离越近，命中越多

s0241.en: Fires a beam that pierces every enemy in its line
s0241.zh: 发射贯穿射线上所有敌人的光线

s0242.en: Barrels need time to spin up before firing
s0242.zh: 开火前需要等待枪管转起来

s0243.en: Plasma rounds that explode while piercing enemies
s0243.zh: 边穿透敌人边爆炸的等离子弹

s0244.en: Grenades that lob in an arc and explode
s0244.zh: 沿抛物线飞行后爆炸的榴弹

s0245.en: Rockets that fly straight and explode
s0245.zh: 直线飞行后爆炸的火箭弹

s0262.zh: 散布 -{}% / 射程 +{}%（仅限霰弹枪）

s0273.zh: 穿透 +{} / 无视敌人装甲

s0276.en: Sets enemies hit on fire for {}s

s0277.en: {}% chance to shock and stall enemies

s0278.en: For {}s after a hit, enemy speed -{}%
s0278.zh: 命中的敌人{}秒内移动速度 -{}%

s0279.zh: 命中时发生小爆炸（威力{}%）

s0305.en: Stocked after ★{} on all Normal stages
s0305.zh: 普通难度全部关卡★{}后上架

s0322.en: Earned by clearing all Part {} stages
s0322.zh: 通关第{}部全部关卡后获得

s0333.en: Earned by clearing Chapter {} on Hard
s0333.zh: 以困难难度通关第{}章全部关卡后获得

s0339.en: Earned by clearing Chapter {} on Nightmare
s0339.zh: 以噩梦难度通关第{}章全部关卡后获得

s0345.zh: 通关第{}部全部{}个关卡后获得

s0365.en: Stocked after a full Nightmare clear
s0365.zh: 噩梦难度全部通关后上架

s0387.en: A citizen possessed by the Fog. Slow, but comes in numbers.
s0387.zh: 被雾附身的市民。动作迟缓，但数量众多。

s0389.en: Wears a track team tracksuit. Very fast. Take it down first.
s0389.zh: 穿着田径队运动服的个体。速度极快，优先击倒它吧。

s0391.en: Spits strong acid from a distance. Jump over the acid puddles it leaves.
s0391.zh: 保持距离喷吐强酸。脚下的酸液池可以跳跃躲开。

s0393.en: Swollen with gas. Explodes when it gets close. Shoot it from afar to catch nearby zombies in the blast.
s0393.zh: 体内积满气体的个体。靠近就会自爆。在远处射击可以波及周围的僵尸。

s0395.en: Kicks off walls to pounce on you. Strike the moment it lands.
s0395.zh: 蹬墙扑过来。落地的瞬间就是机会。

s0397.en: Once a riot police officer. Cuts frontal gunfire damage by {}0%. AP rounds, explosions and crits work well.
s0397.zh: 曾是防暴警察。来自正面的子弹伤害减少{}成。穿甲弹、爆炸、暴击对它有效。

s0399.en: Its shriek calls for help and sends nearby zombies into a frenzy. Top priority target.
s0399.zh: 用尖叫召集同伴，让周围的僵尸狂暴化。最优先目标。

s0401.en: A massive mutant. It never flinches, and its blows send you flying.
s0401.zh: 巨大的变异个体。不会硬直，被它打中会被远远击飞。

s0403.en: A sobbing female zombie that closes in at a brisk pace. Faster than a Walker.
s0403.zh: 一边啜泣一边快步逼近的女性僵尸。比行尸更快。

s0405.en: A man infested by fungus. Throws spore clumps and leaves a poison pool where it falls.
s0405.zh: 被蘑菇寄生的男人。投掷孢子团，倒下的地方也会留下毒液池。

s0407.en: A hulk swinging a chain with huge reach. When it winds up, back off or dodge in close.
s0407.zh: 挥舞锁链的巨汉，攻击范围极广。它抡起锁链时，要么拉开距离，要么闪避冲进它怀里。

s0409.en: An armored giant with an axe. Deflects {}0% of frontal gunfire. Use AP rounds, explosions, crits, or hit it from behind.
s0409.zh: 身披铠甲、手持巨斧的巨人。能弹开{}成来自正面的子弹。用穿甲弹、爆炸、暴击，或从背后攻击。

s0411.en: A witch who fires fireballs straight at you. Jump or dodge to avoid them.
s0411.zh: 直线发射火球的女巫。火球可以跳跃或闪避躲开。

s0413.en: A noblewoman zombie who never stops dancing. Each twirl heals nearby zombies. Take her out first.
s0413.zh: 不停起舞的贵妇僵尸。每次舞动都会治愈周围僵尸的伤势。最好第一个解决她。

s0415.en: Rotten pigeons. Weak, but they swarm in flocks. Clear them out with an SMG or shotgun.
s0415.zh: 腐烂的鸽子。很弱，但会成群涌来。用冲锋枪或霰弹枪一网打尽吧。

s0417.en: A crow whose head is bare bone. Hovers at a distance, then dives at you.
s0417.zh: 头部化为白骨的乌鸦。在远处振翅，然后猛扑过来。

s0419.en: Zombie wolves that run in packs. Very fast, and they leap to bite from far away.
s0419.zh: 成群奔跑的僵尸狼。速度极快，会从远处扑来撕咬。

s0421.en: A giant zombie eagle. One mighty flap carries it a long way in a single swoop.
s0421.zh: 巨大的僵尸鹰。用力振翅，一口气扑出很远的距离。

s0423.en: A zombie bear still walking with arrows in it. Top-tier HP and attack, and faster than a Brute.
s0423.zh: 身上还插着箭的僵尸熊。体力和攻击力都是顶级，比蛮力者更快。

s0425.en: Former vice principal, Kirigaoka Girls' High
s0425.zh: 雾丘女子高中 教导主任

s0426.en: Catchphrase: "No running in the halls!" Now it comes running at you.
s0426.zh: 口头禅是「走廊上不许奔跑」。现在却自己朝你跑了过来。

s0428.en: Former owner, Sakura St. Butcher Shop

s0429.en: A kind shopkeeper who used to throw in a free croquette. Jump over the shockwaves from its ground slams.
s0429.zh: 曾是会多送你一个可乐饼的和善老板。砸地产生的冲击波可以跳跃躲开。

s0431.en: Former crew, Kirigaoka Line last train
s0431.zh: 雾丘线 末班列车 乘务员

s0432.en: Never lets anyone rush aboard. Charges again and again.
s0432.zh: 绝不容许任何人抢上车。会连续冲撞过来。

s0434.zh: 市立综合医院 院长

s0435.en: Knew the truth about the Fog and covered it up. Rains down strong acid.
s0435.zh: 明知雾的真相却加以隐瞒的男人。会像下雨一样降下强酸。

s0437.en: Heart of the Reactor — The First One
s0437.zh: 发生炉之心 ― 最初的那个人

s0438.en: The first test subject, still spawning the Fog. Uses every attack and grows wilder as its HP drops.
s0438.zh: 不断产生雾的最初实验体。会使用所有攻击，体力越低越狂暴。

s0440.zh: 潮见海滨浴场 救生员

s0441.en: "Please stay inside the swimming area." Dashes from one end of the beach to the other in an instant.
s0441.zh: 「请不要离开游泳区域」。一瞬间就能从海滩一端冲到另一端。

s0443.en: Sayoko Shiomi, former director of Helios Pharmaceuticals Lab 4
s0443.zh: 赫利俄斯制药 第四研究所 所长 潮见小夜子

s0444.en: The researcher who first made the Fog drug. Cloaked in the sea fog itself, she uses every attack.
s0444.zh: 最早制造出雾之药的研究者。身披海雾本身，会使用所有攻击。

s0448.en: The Smell of Croquettes Is Gone
s0448.zh: 再也闻不到可乐饼的香味

s0450.en: What Comes After the Last Train
s0450.zh: 末班车之后到来的东西

s0453.zh: 港湾·赫利俄斯第三研究所

s0456.en: Part {}: Summer Fog from the Sea
s0456.zh: 第{}部·夏日之雾自海上来

s0500.en: Clutching her little brother's shoe, Haru slipped out the back door of the croquette shop. Shadows were gathering from both ends of the street.
s0500.zh: 小春紧紧攥着弟弟的鞋，从可乐饼店的后门走了出来。街道两头，黑影正在聚拢。

s0501.en: Haru, don't move. Stay behind the crates. ...I'm on the roof across the street.
s0501.zh: 小春，别动。躲在木箱后面。……我在对面的楼顶。

s0502.en: Rei!? When did you get up there—
s0502.zh: 玲！？你什么时候跑上去的——

s0503.en: Borrowed sniper rifle. Range {}, no wind. One headshot drops them.
s0503.zh: 借来的狙击枪。距离{}，无风。打头一枪就能放倒。

s0504.en: Shoot an orange one and it takes the others with it. —Not one of them touches you.
s0504.zh: 橙色的一打就会波及周围。——我不会让任何一只碰到你。

s0505.en: Rei headed for the examination room. From the ward across the way, Yui watched her path back through a scope.
s0505.zh: 玲前往了诊察室。在对面的病栋里，结衣正透过瞄准镜守望着她的归途。

s0506.en: Rei, can you hear me? They're coming from both ends of the hall. Grab the files and wait behind the bench.
s0506.zh: 玲，听得到吗？走廊两头都有东西过来。拿好资料，在长椅后面等着。

s0507.en: ...You were watching? I said I'd go alone.
s0507.zh: ……你一直在看着？我明明说了要一个人去。

s0508.en: I said I'd let you go alone. I never said I'd leave you alone.
s0508.zh: 我是说过让你一个人去，可没说过要丢下你一个人。

s0509.en: The fireball throwers will aim from range. Helmets deflect headshots, so go for the body. —Covering fire, starting now!
s0509.zh: 会扔火球的家伙会从远处瞄准。头盔能弹开子弹，所以打身体。——掩护，开始！

s0510.en: The main entrance is blocked. Our only way out is across the walkway and through the gym.
s0510.zh: 正门被堵住了。只能穿过连廊，从体育馆那边出去。

s0511.en: The walkway? It's totally open. They'll see us from the whole field!
s0511.zh: 连廊？那里四面透风啊。从操场上看得一清二楚吧？

s0512.en: Look look, the ones in tracksuits are fast! The track team's still running even as zombies!
s0512.zh: 快看快看，穿运动服的那些好快！田径部变成僵尸了还在跑！

s0513.en: Take down the fast ones first. Keep formation!
s0513.zh: 先解决跑得快的。别打乱队形！

s0514.en: Too many of them at the gate... Let's fall back to the gym storeroom and regroup.
s0514.zh: 校门口的数量太多了……先退回体育仓库，重新整顿。

s0515.en: Mio's gonna build a barricade outta mats and vaulting boxes. Gimme {} seconds!
s0515.zh: 我用垫子和跳箱搭个路障哦。给我{}秒！

s0516.en: {} seconds!? That's forever! ...Fine, nothing's getting past me!
s0516.zh: {}秒！？好久！……行吧，一只都别想过去！

s0517.en: They're coming from both sides. Watch each other's backs.
s0517.zh: 两边都来了。背靠背守住。

s0518.en: Before the school gate stood a shadow far larger than the rest.
s0518.zh: 校门前，立着一个格外巨大的身影。

s0519.en: That tie... is that the Vice Principal!? He's HUGE!!
s0519.zh: 那条领带……是教导主任！？好大只！！

s0520.en: Seems the longer they breathe the Fog, the bigger they get. His body glows red before he charges. Don't miss it.
s0520.zh: 看来吸雾越久的个体，体型越大。冲撞之前身体会发红光。别看漏了。

s0521.en: ...Vice Principal. School's out. Please, let us through!
s0521.zh: ……教导主任。放学时间到了。请让我们过去！

s0522.en: The Fog's all trapped inside the arcade. Can't see a thing~
s0522.zh: 商店街里面雾都闷住了。视野好差～

s0523.en: Screaming from the back. Could be a survivor. Could be a Screamer.
s0523.zh: 里面有尖叫声。可能是幸存者，也可能是尖叫者。

s0524.en: Either way we gotta go! Shoot the orange ones before they get close—they explode!
s0524.zh: 不管是哪个都得去吧！橙色的家伙要在靠近之前打掉，会爆炸的！

s0525.en: Watch out for the pigeons too. ...I can't believe even the birds...
s0525.zh: 也要小心鸽子。……没想到连鸟都……

s0526.en: Behind the croquette shop, Haru found one of her brother's shoes. Just one.
s0526.zh: 在可乐饼店后面，小春只找到了弟弟的一只鞋。

s0527.en: ...It's still new. He's close. I know he is!
s0527.zh: ……还是新的。他就在附近。一定在！

s0528.en: Footsteps are closing in. We have to hold them here until the butcher's shutter is open.
s0528.zh: 脚步声在聚集。在打开肉铺的卷帘门之前，只能在这里挡住它们。

s0529.en: Lockpicking, {} seconds! Keep the zombies off Mio, 'kay~!
s0529.zh: 开锁，{}秒！僵尸就拜托你们挡一下啦～！

s0530.en: The shutter rose. Before the walk-in fridge stood a hulking figure, a cleaver hanging from its hand.
s0530.zh: 卷帘门升起。冷库前，一个提着剁肉刀的庞然身影挡住了去路。

s0531.en: Mister... The kids are back there, aren't they? Were you protecting them?
s0531.zh: 大叔……里面有孩子们对吧。你一直在保护他们吗？

s0532.en: He can't understand us anymore. When he slams the ground, a shockwave runs out. Jump over it.
s0532.zh: 他已经听不懂话了。砸地的时候会放出冲击波。跳起来躲开。

s0533.en: ...Sorry, mister. Your croquettes were the best!
s0533.zh: ……对不起，大叔。你的可乐饼，真的很好吃！

s0534.en: From here, we walk the tracks. It's a straight shot to the next station.
s0534.zh: 接下来沿着铁轨走。到下一站只有一条路。

s0535.en: A straight shot means they can only come from the front and back, right? ...Wait, that means they're coming from the front AND back?
s0535.zh: 只有一条路，就是说它们只会从前后来吧。……也就是说会从前后一起来吧？

s0536.en: There are ones that kick off the walls to leap at you, and wolves. Stay sharp even at a distance.
s0536.zh: 有会蹬墙跳过来的个体，还有狼。就算隔着距离也别大意。

s0537.en: It's too dark to see, so I'll just blow up anything suspicious in advance!
s0537.zh: 太暗了看不清，可疑的地方我就先炸掉了哦！

s0539.en: The moment they reached the platform, every light went out.
s0539.zh: 刚登上站台，所有的灯就一齐熄灭了。

s0540.en: Whoa, blackout! Backup power's gonna take like {} seconds to kick in!
s0540.zh: 哇，停电了！切换到备用电源大概要{}秒！

s0541.en: Move in the dark and you'll fall onto the tracks. We hold here.
s0541.zh: 在黑暗里乱动会掉下铁轨。就在原地迎击。

s0542.en: The ones with mushrooms leave poison behind even after they're dead, so don't step in it!
s0542.zh: 长蘑菇的那种，打倒以后毒还会留在地上，别踩到啊！

s0543.en: A train that should have been the last of the night glided into the station. There was no one in the driver's seat.
s0543.zh: 本该是末班车的列车，缓缓滑进了站台。驾驶座上，空无一人。

s0544.en: The doors opened... Did you hear it say "Thank you for riding with us"?
s0544.zh: 门开了……刚才是不是听到了一句“感谢您的乘坐”？

s0545.en: The conductor. He charges over and over. Hit him right after he slams into a wall.
s0545.zh: 是列车员。他会连续冲撞好几次。撞到墙上的那一刻就是机会。

s0546.en: We're getting off at the next station. —You're letting us through!
s0546.zh: 我们要在前面那站下车。——请让我们过去！

s0547.en: Ward Three. Where the first infected patients were brought in.
s0547.zh: 第三病栋。最早一批感染者被送进来的地方。

s0548.en: Ugh... every bed's empty. So they all just... walked out?
s0548.zh: 呜哇……床全都是空的。意思是大家都自己走出去了？

s0549.en: Is that guy in the lab coat throwing FIREBALLS!? Is that what medicine is now!?
s0549.zh: 那个穿白大褂的是不是在放火球！？医疗是这样的吗！？

s0550.en: Fireballs fly straight. Jump, or dodge right through them!
s0550.zh: 火球是直线飞来的。跳起来，或者用闪避穿过去！

s0551.en: I found the antiserum. But it takes {} seconds to thaw. Guard the pharmacy until then.
s0551.zh: 找到抗血清了。但解冻要{}秒。这段时间守住药剂部。

s0552.en: {} seconds, got it! Should we just seal the entrance? With explosives!
s0552.zh: {}秒对吧！入口干脆堵上吧？用爆破！

s0553.en: That would blow up the medicine too. Don't.

s0554.en: The dancing one in the dress heals everything around her. Take her out first the moment you see her.
s0554.zh: 跳舞的那个穿礼服的会给周围回血。一看到就优先打倒。

s0555.en: Beyond the director's door, slow footsteps approached, as if making the rounds.
s0555.zh: 院长室的门后，查房般的脚步声正缓缓逼近。

s0556.en: The hospital director... The man who knew what the Fog was, and hid it.
s0556.zh: 院长……知道雾的真面目，却隐瞒了的人。

s0558.en: He wasn't here. So there's still hope. ...The director rains down acid. Watch your footing.
s0558.zh: 他不在这里。所以，还有希望。……院长会像下雨一样洒下强酸。注意脚下。

s0559.en: Let's go. He has the answers.
s0559.zh: 走吧。答案就在这个人手里。

s0560.en: The lab's security system is still live. Every time we open a bulkhead, whatever's inside comes out.
s0560.zh: 研究所里的警备系统还在运作。每开一道隔离门，里面的东西就会跑出来哦。

s0561.en: Armored ones, and bears. Even the lab animals got hit by the Fog... Punch through their front armor with AP rounds or explosives.
s0561.zh: 穿铠甲的个体，还有熊。连实验动物都被雾……正面装甲要用穿甲弹或者爆炸来打穿。

s0563.en: I'm counting on you, Nana. All {} sections—we push straight through!
s0563.zh: 就靠你了，奈奈。全部{}个区块，一口气冲过去！

s0564.en: The generator's control room. Entering the shutdown code would take {} seconds.
s0564.zh: 发生炉的控制室。输入停止代码需要{}秒。

s0565.en: This is gonna be the longest {} seconds of Mio's whole life... Can't take my hands off this, so!
s0565.zh: 这大概会是澪酱有史以来最长的{}秒……我手可离不开哦！

s0566.en: Every one of them in the tower is heading here. This is our last line of defense.
s0566.zh: 整座塔里的个体都在往这边来。这是最后的防线。

s0567.en: Bring it! I'll hold out till morning if I have to!
s0567.zh: 来得好！撑到天亮都没问题！

s0568.zh: 全员，保护澪。——绝对，不让它们过去！

s0569.en: At the bottom of the core, it quietly opened its eyes. The first one—the source of all the Fog.
s0569.zh: 在炉心底部，它静静地睁开了眼睛。不断生出雾的，最初的那个人。

s0570.en: Patient Zero... The test subject from my father's notes. They were only ever waiting for a cure.
s0570.zh: 零号病人……父亲笔记里提到的受试者。这个人，也只是在等待治疗而已。

s0571.en: It goes wilder the lower its health gets, right? So don't let up till the very end!
s0571.zh: 血越少就闹得越凶对吧。意思是到最后都不能松懈！

s0573.en: Let's end this. For them, and for the town. —Airsoft Club, final operation: commence!
s0573.zh: 结束这一切吧。为了这个人，也为了这座城市。——生存游戏社，最终行动，开始！

s0574.en: Senpai, let me take a quick detour! There's still ammo for "that thing" in the storeroom!
s0574.zh: 学姐，让我稍微绕个路！仓库里还剩着“那个”的弹药！

s0576.en: It's fine! If I caught you all in the blast in a narrow hallway, that'd be way more dangerous!
s0576.zh: 没事的！要是在狭窄的通道里把学姐们也炸进去，那才更危险！

s0577.en: ...What's annoying is that her logic holds up. Be back in five minutes.
s0577.zh: ……偏偏道理说得通，真让人火大。五分钟内回来。

s0578.en: That croquette shop's got a tiny back door. If we all go, we'll get boxed in. ...I'll go check it out alone.
s0578.zh: 那家可乐饼店后门很窄。大家一起去会被包围的。……我一个人去看看。

s0580.en: He's my little brother. His big sister's gotta go. I'll be right back, so hold the front!
s0580.zh: 那是我弟弟啊。姐姐不去谁去。我马上回来，你们守好前面！

s0581.en: Don't say stuff that sounds like a death flag~... Keep your radio on, 'kay?
s0581.zh: 别说这种像立flag的话嘛～……对讲机一直开着哦。

s0582.en: The platform's emergency door is on an electronic lock. We can't go on until the power room is rebooted.
s0582.zh: 站台的紧急门被电子锁锁住了。不重启配电室就没法前进。

s0583.en: A switchboard? That's Mio's time to shine. But the shutter on the way's welded shut, y'know?
s0583.zh: 配电盘的话就轮到澪酱出场了。不过半路上的卷帘门被焊死了哦？

s0584.zh: 卷帘门交给奈奈来开！用物理手段！

s0585.en: ...I'm really nervous about sending these two together.
s0585.zh: ……让这两个人一起去，我真的很不放心。

s0586.en: Tech and firepower. A rational pairing. —Don't break too much.
s0586.zh: 技术加火力。合理的人选。——别破坏过头。

s0587.en: My father's examination room is up ahead. ...Let me go alone from here.
s0587.zh: 前面就是父亲的诊察室。……接下来，让我一个人去。

s0588.en: Huh!? Why!? You said we'd go together!
s0588.zh: 哈！？为什么啊，不是说好一起去的吗！

s0589.en: If my father has crossed over to "the other side," I have to be the one who shoots. I don't want anyone else carrying that.
s0589.zh: 如果父亲已经变成了“那一边”的人，开枪的必须是我。我不想让任何人背负这些。

s0590.en: ...All right. But promise me you'll come back. That's an order from your club president.
s0590.zh: ……我知道了。但你要答应我，一定要回来。这是社长命令。

s0592.en: The bridge to the generator was only wide enough for two.
s0592.zh: 通往发生炉的连接桥，只有两个人的宽度。

s0593.en: Rei and I will go. You three, secure our way out.
s0593.zh: 这里我和玲去。你们三个确保退路。

s0594.en: Aww, but it's the big finale!
s0594.zh: 诶——明明是最后的高光时刻！

s0595.en: If the bridge falls, we're all finished. I'll cross first and open the door from the other side. President, I'm leaving my back to you.
s0595.zh: 桥塌了大家都完了。我先过去，从对面开门。社长，后背就交给你了。

s0596.en: Yeah. It's been that way since the day you joined, hasn't it?
s0596.zh: 嗯。从入社那天起，一直都是这样的吧。

s0597.en: August. Ten months had passed since that night of Fog.
s0597.zh: 八月。距离那个雾夜，已经过去了十个月。

s0598.en: For their summer training camp, the Airsoft Club was riding a ferry to the remote isle of Shiomi Island.
s0598.zh: 生存游戏社为了夏季集训，正乘着渡轮摇摇晃晃地前往离岛——潮见岛。

s0599.en: Look look, the ocean! An island camp on the club budget? That's gotta be a first in Kirigaoka history!
s0599.zh: 快看快看，大海！用社团经费去离岛集训，这可是雾丘建校以来的壮举吧？

s0600.en: It's not the club budget. My father booked the inn "for the girls who saved my daughter's life."
s0600.zh: 不是社团经费。是我父亲说“给女儿的救命恩人们”，帮我们订了民宿。

s0601.en: Rei's dad is the best! First thing when we land, I'm swimming! Then shaved ice!
s0601.zh: 玲的爸爸最棒了！到了先去游泳！然后吃刨冰！

s0602.en: Senpai, I brought fireworks! The big aerial kind!
s0602.zh: 学姐，奈奈带了烟花来！是往天上放的那种！

s0603.zh: ……奈奈，那个，你是从哪儿弄来的？

s0604.en: The moment the ferry reached the pier, a white wall rose from the open sea. A thick fog that had no business existing on a summer evening.
s0604.zh: 渡轮靠上栈桥的那一刻，一堵白墙从海面上涌了起来。在夏日傍晚本不该出现的浓雾。

s0605.en: This color... it's the same as that night. But we shut down the generator.
s0605.zh: 这个颜色……和那天晚上一样。可发生炉明明已经停了。

s0606.en: There's a giant building out at sea. Helios logo... it says "Fourth Laboratory."
s0606.zh: 海上有栋超大的建筑。赫利俄斯的标志……上面写着“第四研究所”。

s0607.en: ...Camp is canceled. Airsoft Club, operation start. We all make it out alive, and we take our summer back!
s0607.zh: ……集训取消。生存游戏社，行动开始。大家一起活下来，把暑假夺回来！

s0608.en: No way, every beach shack's turned into a zombie food stall... The worst part is it still smells like yakisoba.
s0608.zh: 不会吧，海滩小屋全变成僵尸摊位了……只剩炒面的香味还在，太难受了。

s0609.en: There's one running at us still wearing a swim ring!? Isn't it kinda fast!?
s0609.zh: 有个套着游泳圈跑过来的耶！？是不是有点快！？

s0610.en: Even tourists in swimsuits... The whole island's been swallowed by the Fog.
s0610.zh: 连穿泳衣的游客都……整座岛都被雾吞没了啊。

s0611.en: The people from the inn should be sheltering at the end of the pier. Let's get through the street and meet up with them!
s0611.zh: 民宿的人应该在栈桥尽头避难。穿过街道去和他们会合！

s0612.en: The beach shack "Shiosai." The island's children who had fled there were hiding behind the counter.
s0612.zh: 海滩小屋“潮骚”。避难的岛上孩子们，正躲在柜台后面。

s0613.en: Senpai, they say the ferry won't be back for {} seconds!
s0613.zh: 学姐，说是渡轮回来还要{}秒！

s0614.en: Barricade with the beach umbrellas and benches! ...Man, I've gotten way too good at this.
s0614.zh: 用遮阳伞和长椅搭路障！……我居然变得擅长干这种事了。

s0615.en: They won't lay a finger on those kids. Both sides, here they come!
s0615.zh: 绝不让它们碰孩子们一根手指。两边都来了！

s0616.en: After sending the children off on the ferry, their friends were nearly surrounded behind the crates on the pier. From atop the lighthouse, Mio looked down.
s0616.zh: 把孩子们送上渡轮的伙伴们，在栈桥的木箱后面快被包围了。灯塔顶上，澪正俯视着下方。

s0617.en: Pochi, sync camera. ...Okay, aim correction's good. Today, Mio's playing sniper.
s0617.zh: 波奇，相机同步。……好，瞄准校正OK。澪酱今天要当狙击手哦。

s0618.en: Mio, you're sniping? Are you sure about this?

s0619.en: Y'know, the Discipline Committee's whole job is spotting rule-breakers from far away. —Anyone running on the beach is in violation!
s0619.zh: 风纪委员啊，工作就是从远处找出违规的人。——在沙滩上乱跑的，全员违规！

s0620.en: We're pinned here for {} seconds until the ferry leaves. Mio, cover us!
s0620.zh: 渡轮开走前的{}秒，我们动不了。澪，拜托掩护！

s0621.en: The ferry carrying the children pulled away. As if answering its horn, something atop the watchtower blew a whistle.
s0621.zh: 载着孩子们的渡轮渐渐远去。仿佛在回应那声汽笛，瞭望塔上，有什么东西吹响了哨子。

s0622.en: That whistle... it's the lifeguard. Last summer, he saved a kid who was drowning.
s0622.zh: 那个哨声……是救生员。听说去年夏天，他救过一个差点溺水的孩子。

s0623.en: He closes the whole length of the beach in an instant. After he charges, hit him when his feet sink into the sand.
s0623.zh: 他能一瞬间从海滩这头冲到那头。冲撞之后，趁他脚陷进沙子的瞬间打。

s0624.en: ...No one else is drowning on this beach. Let's go!
s0624.zh: ……不会再让任何人在这片海滩溺水了。上吧！

s0625.en: From the fallen lifeguard's waterproof pouch came a Helios employee ID. On the back, a handwritten note.
s0625.zh: 倒下的救生员的防水袋里，掉出了一张赫利俄斯的员工证。背面有一行手写的字。

s0626.en: "The Fourth Laboratory is culturing the Fog's 'stock solution' in seawater. The generator was a decoy"...!
s0626.zh: “第四研究所正在用海水培养雾的‘原液’。发生炉只是诱饵”……！

s0627.en: A decoy...? So the thing we stopped that night wasn't the real deal?
s0627.zh: 诱饵……那就是说，那天晚上我们关掉的不是本体？

s0628.en: Then we just blow up the real one too! I still have fireworks left!
s0628.zh: 那把本体也炸掉就行了吧！烟花还有剩！

s0629.en: We need a boat to reach the lab offshore. Let's head to the island's fishing port.
s0629.zh: 要去海上的研究所得有船。去岛上的渔港吧。

s0630.en: The fishing port at night. Only one boat still ran, and the fuel tank sat on the far side of the cold storage.
s0630.zh: 夜晚的渔港。能动的船只有一艘，燃料罐在冷冻仓库的另一头。

s0631.en: I'll haul the fuel. And anything in the way—
s0631.zh: 燃料我来扛。至于碍事的家伙——

s0633.en: ...Sending just these two makes me even more nervous than the power room did.
s0633.zh: ……只让这两个人去，比配电室那次还让人不放心。

s0634.en: Muscle and firepower. A rational pairing. —Don't blow up the whole port.
s0634.zh: 力气加火力。合理的人选。——别把港口一起炸飞了。

s0636.en: Inside the cold storage, the surviving fishermen had barricaded themselves.
s0636.zh: 冷冻仓库里，幸存的渔民们正据守其中。

s0637.en: {} seconds to start the boat's engine! It's an old model, so even Mio needs a bit!
s0637.zh: 船的引擎发动要{}秒！是老型号，就算是澪酱也要花点时间！

s0638.en: {} seconds? Easy... is what I wanna say, but isn't the crowd outside kinda insane?
s0638.zh: {}秒的话小意思……虽然很想这么说，但外面的数量是不是有点不妙？

s0639.en: The Fog is flowing into the port. Their numbers are only going to grow.
s0639.zh: 雾正在往港口里涌。数量只会越来越多。

s0640.en: We meet them at the door. No one gets inside the warehouse!
s0640.zh: 在门前迎击。谁都别想进仓库！

s0641.en: The lab's control signal is coming from the lighthouse antenna. Unless someone cuts it, the boat can't get close.
s0641.zh: 研究所的控制信号是从灯塔的天线发出来的。不切断的话，船就没法靠近。

s0643.en: No. The lighthouse stairs only fit one person. Besides, I need all of you to protect the boat.
s0643.zh: 不。灯塔的楼梯只有一个人的宽度。而且，我想让大家守住船。

s0644.en: Yui, that's the same thing Rei said before. "Let me go alone."
s0644.zh: 结衣，这不就是之前玲说过的话嘛。“让我一个人去”。

s0645.en: Yeah. Which is why I'm coming back too. A president can give orders to herself, you know.
s0645.zh: 嗯。所以我也一定会回来。社长命令，也可以下给自己的哦。

s0646.en: ...Understood, President. If you don't come back, I'll never forgive you.
s0646.zh: ……收到，社长。要是你没回来，我绝不原谅你。

s0647.en: The lighthouse signal died, and beyond the Fog, a bridge to the lab came into view.
s0647.zh: 灯塔的信号中断了，雾的另一头，浮现出通往研究所的连接桥。

s0648.en: All the lab's security drones just shut down! Nice one, Yui!
s0648.zh: 研究所的警备无人机全停了！结衣，干得漂亮！

s0649.en: I'm back. ...Sorry to keep you all waiting.
s0649.zh: 我回来了。……让大家久等了，对不起。

s0651.en: The bridge has six sections. Some of them climb up from the sea. Keep moving.
s0651.zh: 桥有六个区块。还有从海里爬上来的个体。别停下脚步。

s0653.en: The deepest level of the lab. Before a giant tank filled with seawater stood a woman in a white coat.
s0653.zh: 研究所的最深处。在灌满海水的巨大水槽前，站着一位身穿白大褂的女性。

s0654.en: Director Sayoko Shiomi... My father's co-author. The one who first made the Fog drug.
s0654.zh: 潮见小夜子所长……父亲论文的共同研究者。最早制造出雾之药的人。

s0655.en: The woman slowly turned. From her body, the Fog poured out like a wave.
s0655.zh: 女人缓缓转过身来。雾从她的身体里，如波浪般涌了出来。

s0656.zh: 这个人，已经变成雾本身了……！

s0657.en: She's HUGE! Like, three times bigger than the Vice Principal!?
s0657.zh: 好大！差不多有教导主任的三倍大吧！？

s0659.en: Let's end this—for real this time. —Airsoft Club, last operation of summer break: commence!
s0659.zh: 结束吧，这次一定。——生存游戏社，暑假最后的行动，开始！

s0660.en: The tank shattered, and morning light poured into the lab. The sea fog came undone in the salt breeze.
s0660.zh: 水槽碎裂，晨光照进了研究所。海上的雾，在海风中渐渐散开。

s0661.en: ...All the Fog's stock solution has gone back to seawater. This time, it's really over.
s0661.zh: ……雾的原液，全部变回了海水。这一次，真的结束了。

s0662.en: The sound of rescue helicopters drew near. Aboard one was Rei's father, in his white coat.
s0662.zh: 救援直升机的声音越来越近。其中，有身穿白大褂的玲的父亲。

s0663.en: We're DONE! Okay, swimming! Right now!

s0664.en: I wanna sleep first... That's two all-nighters in a row this camp...
s0664.zh: 在那之前我想先睡觉……集训连续两天通宵了啊……

s0665.en: Senpai, the people at the inn say they've got swimsuits ready for us "as thanks"!
s0665.zh: 学姐，民宿的人说“作为谢礼”，给我们准备了泳衣！

s0666.en: ...Yeah. Just for today, club activities are canceled. Let's all go to the beach!
s0666.zh: ……嗯。就今天，社团活动休息。大家一起去海边吧！

s0667.en:
Afterschool Deadline Part {} — The End —
Reward: Swimsuits for the whole team.
s0667.zh:
放学后的死线 第{}部 —— 完 ——
奖励：获得了全员的泳衣。

s0668.en: October, after school. A gray fog descended on the town of Kirigaoka.
s0668.zh: 十月，放学后。灰色的雾，降临在雾丘的街道上。

s0669.en: Anyone who breathed the Fog stopped being human within thirty minutes.
s0669.zh: 吸入雾的人，三十分钟后便不再是“人”。

s0670.en: W-wait! Those things on the field aren't the track team, right!?
s0670.zh: 等、等一下！操场上那些，不是田径部的吧！？

s0671.en: Pupils dilated, no response to voice. ...They're biting. Confirmed. Zombies.
s0671.zh: 瞳孔放大，呼唤无反应。……在咬人。确定了，是僵尸。

s0672.en: Wow. So, do we open it? Our advisor's "DO NOT TOUCH" locker?
s0672.zh: 哇哦。那要不要打开那个？顾问的“绝对不许碰”储物柜。

s0673.en: ...Forgive me, Mr. Onizuka. Just for today, the Airsoft Club is using the real thing.
s0673.zh: ……鬼冢老师，对不起。就今天，生存游戏社要用真家伙了。

s0674.en: Senpai! There's a bazooka in the school festival storeroom! It's labeled "stage prop"!
s0674.zh: 学姐！文化祭的仓库里有火箭筒！上面写着“表演道具”！

s0675.en: ...What kind of school festival is this.

s0676.en: Objective: everyone lives to see morning. —Operation start!
s0676.zh: 目标：全员活着迎来早晨。——行动开始！

s0677.en: The Vice Principal... right to the end, he had that "no running in the halls" look on his face...
s0677.zh: 教导主任……到最后都是一副“走廊上不许跑”的表情……

s0678.en: Fog outside the gate too. The source is toward the harbor. I can work it out backward from wind direction and density.
s0678.zh: 校门外也是雾。源头在港口方向。根据风向和浓度可以反推出来。

s0679.en: The harbor? That's where the Helios Pharmaceuticals lab is. Suuuper suspicious~
s0679.zh: 说到港口，不就是赫利俄斯制药的研究所嘛。可疑度满分～

s0680.en: A research lab probably has spare rockets too! Let's go!
s0680.zh: 研究所的话应该也有备用火箭弹吧！走吧！

s0681.en: The shopping street first. We'll secure food and ammo, and look for survivors.
s0681.zh: 先去商店街。确保食物和弹药，寻找幸存者。

s0682.en: Sakura Street... Forget a ghost town of shuttered shops—it's a zombie town now.
s0682.zh: 樱花街……别说是卷帘门商店街了，简直成了僵尸街。

s0683.en: That croquette shop over there—me and my little brother used to go all the time. ...Hope the brat's okay.
s0683.zh: 那边那家可乐饼店，我以前常和弟弟一起去。……那小子，没事吧。

s0684.en: We'll find him, Haru. That's why we're taking this detour, right?
s0684.zh: 去找吧，小春。我们绕路不就是为了这个吗。

s0685.en: Correction. It's not a detour. It's Mission Objective Two.
s0685.zh: 更正。不是绕路，是作战目标之二。

s0686.en: The butcher... he always gave me an extra croquette...
s0686.zh: 肉铺的大叔……明明每次都多送我一个可乐饼的……

s0687.en: Deep in the walk-in fridge were the trembling children. Among them was Haru's little brother.
s0687.zh: 冷库深处，有一群瑟瑟发抖的孩子。其中，也有小春的弟弟。

s0688.en: ...Ngh, you idiot! Don't scare me like that!

s0689.en: The kids are coughing. Early symptoms of the Fog. We need the antiserum from the hospital.
s0689.zh: 孩子在咳嗽。是雾的初期症状。需要医院的抗血清。

s0690.en: The Fog's too thick on the surface. We'll walk the subway tracks to City Hospital.
s0690.zh: 地面上的雾太浓了。沿着地铁轨道走，去市立医院吧。

s0691.en: Feels like the last train left a looong time ago, huh.
s0691.zh: 末班车，感觉早就开走了呢。

s0692.en: The Fog is heavier than air. Underground, it's... thicker than above.
s0692.zh: 雾比空气重。地下……比上面更浓。

s0693.en: Wait, then why'd we come underground!?
s0693.zh: 诶，那为什么还要来地下！？

s0694.en: Because there are three times as many zombies on the surface.
s0694.zh: 因为地面上的僵尸是这里的三倍。

s0695.en: Six of one, half a dozen of the other... Watch your step. Let's go.
s0695.zh: 半斤八两……注意脚下，走吧。

s0696.en: The conductor kept saying "Please do not rush onto the train" right to the end... Total commitment, huh.
s0696.zh: 列车员先生到最后都在说“请勿抢上抢下”……真是始终如一啊。

s0697.en: There was a log left on the conductor's terminal. On the night of the Fog, only the freight trains bound for the harbor were running.
s0697.zh: 列车员的终端里留有记录。雾夜里，只有开往港口的货运列车还在运行。

s0698.en: What they're carrying is... culture tanks? It's Helios Pharmaceuticals after all.
s0698.zh: 运的是……培养罐？果然是赫利俄斯制药。

s0699.en: Medicine first! The hospital's right above us!
s0699.zh: 先拿药！医院就在正上方！

s0700.en: Kirigaoka City General Hospital. Only the emergency lights lit the halls, in shades of green.
s0700.zh: 雾丘市立综合医院。只有应急灯，把走廊照成了绿色。

s0701.en: The antiserum's in the basement pharmacy. And—I want to check the director's records.
s0701.zh: 抗血清在地下的药剂部。还有——我想确认院长的记录。

s0702.en: Rei-rei, your face is kinda scary right now?

s0703.en: ...My father is a doctor here. He was on duty the night of the Fog.
s0703.zh: ……我父亲是这里的医生。雾夜那天，他在值班。

s0704.en: We'll look together. It's okay. You've got us.
s0704.zh: 一起找吧。没事的，有我们在。

s0705.en: A single note fell from the white coat of the monstrous director. It was in Rei's father's handwriting.
s0705.zh: 从变成怪物的院长的白大褂里，掉出了一张便条。是玲父亲的字迹。

s0706.en: "The Fog is not a weapon. It is a failed drug. If the generator is stopped, some can still be brought back."
s0706.zh: “雾不是武器，是失败的药。只要让发生炉停下，还有人能变回来。”

s0707.en: Brought back...!? So the people who were only bitten recently could be...!
s0707.zh: 能变回来……！？那，刚被咬没多久的人也！

s0708.en: It's possible. My father went to the lab. To stop it.
s0708.zh: 有这个可能。父亲去了研究所。为了阻止这一切。

s0709.en: Let's go. To the harbor. Three hours until dawn.
s0709.zh: 走吧，去港口。离天亮还有三个小时。

s0710.en: The harbor district. Helios Pharmaceuticals, Third Laboratory. The heart of the Fog.
s0710.zh: 港湾地区，赫利俄斯制药第三研究所。雾的心脏。

s0711.en: Leave security to Mio~ ...Annnd it's open. Total joke.
s0711.zh: 安保就交给澪酱吧～……好，开了。漏洞百出。

s0712.en: Look, that tower! The Fog's coming out of there!
s0712.zh: 看，那座塔！雾是从那里冒出来的！

s0713.en: The generator. And inside it is "the first one."
s0713.zh: 发生炉。而且那里面，有“最初的那个人”。

s0714.en: Remaining warheads, check! I'm putting every last one into that tower!
s0714.zh: 奈奈，剩余弹头确认！全部轰进那座塔里！

s0715.en: Everyone, check your ammo. —This is our last club activity.
s0715.zh: 全员，确认剩余弹药。——这是最后的社团活动了。

s0716.en: The generator fell silent, and the tower crumbled. The Fog came undone in the morning wind.
s0716.zh: 发生炉归于沉寂，高塔崩塌。雾，在晨风中渐渐散去。

s0718.en: Beside the rubble, a man in a white coat coughed and weakly raised a hand.
s0718.zh: 瓦砾旁，一个身穿白大褂的男人一边咳嗽，一边微微举起了手。

s0719.en: He's alive! Rei, your dad's alive!!
s0719.zh: 他还活着！玲，你爸爸还活着！！

s0720.en: Look look, the sunrise. Ugh, so bright... We pulled an all-nighter.
s0720.zh: 快看快看，朝阳。哇，好刺眼……我们通宵了耶。

s0721.en: Ehehe... Did I maybe break the tower a little too much?
s0721.zh: 诶嘿嘿……塔是不是稍微炸过头了？

s0722.en: Objective complete. Everyone lived to see morning.
s0722.zh: 目标达成。全员，活着迎来了早晨。

s0723.en: —Airsoft Club, operation complete! ...Let's go home and sleep.
s0723.zh: ——生存游戏社，行动结束！……回家睡觉吧。

s0724.en:
Afterschool Deadline — The End —
On Hard and above, and in Survival, the night of Fog goes on.
s0724.zh:
放学后的死线 —— 完 ——
在困难以上的难度和生存模式中，雾之夜仍将继续。

s0725.en:
...And then, summer.

s0725.zh:
……然后，夏天到了。
